official_report_method_reading.summary: Coastal stability follows CRMP Shoreline Change Study (Baird2015c); this citation is not a universal survey epoch. Erosion hazards use historical profiles, 0.6m LD shoreline extrema and setbacks over a50-year planning period. Unmeasured beaches require judgment; interpolation is less reliable away from stations. Severe storms and subsurface uncertainty remain; defence condition was not assessed. Cliff rates use historical aerial comparisons and cannot represent individual failures. The2015 LiDAR date explicitly supports landslide DEM analysis. Beach valuation trends use10–30years of surveys depending on site. These definitions do not establish a legal parish coast or a common acquisition date for every line.
